claims.statement: The pre-R1 Autumn GLB is 18,189,772 bytes, uses 48 KTX2 textures, retains EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing and EXT_meshopt_compression, and renders 1,977,667 source triangles after instance expansion.
The pre-R1 grounding contract sinks the four exported HeroTreeA placements between 1.036 and 1.430 metres and has no maximum-depth invariant.
Autumn keeps its sculptural Meshy hero grove while botanical descendants provide believable middle and far support.
evidence: Austen approval, 2026-09-01: I'll take your recommendation.

claims.statement: The R1 GLB is 18,340,028 bytes, expands to 2,063,055 source triangles, contains 48/48 KTX2 textures, and retains GPU instancing and meshopt compression.

The R1 production graph renders three performers with trail, fire, and LED effects at 2.497 million triangles and 303 draw calls; GPU P95 measured 7.36 ms at 1920x1080 and 8.10 ms at 3840x2160 in the shared debug Chrome.

The R1 grounding verifier covers 103 placements and 909 central-root samples; hero automatic sink is capped at 0.76 m with a measured 0.703 m maximum, and the restored underground URL is recovered to 0.35 m above its local surface.

exemptions.name: floor-plan
exemptions.rationale: R1 preserves the approved Autumn terrain, stage, pond, cabin, paths, and performer clearing; it corrects camera integrity and asset tiers rather than changing the spatial plan.

exemptions.name: vertical-section
exemptions.rationale: The user identified the below-ground failure from the existing section; R1 preserves terrain elevations and repairs camera/root contracts instead of proposing a new section.

exemptions.name: route-storyboard
exemptions.rationale: The existing free-orbit and walk review routes remain unchanged; R1 changes what those routes may expose.

exemptions.name: sightline-study
exemptions.rationale: The registered Autumn camera set is already encoded in the live review route and becomes the visual regression matrix for R1.

exemptions.name: walkability
exemptions.rationale: R1 does not move the protected performer clearing, paths, cabin, pond, or walk bounds.

exemptions.name: clearance
exemptions.rationale: The deterministic builder's existing performer, path, pond, tree-footprint, and settlement-clearance checks remain authoritative.

exemptions.name: sightlines
exemptions.rationale: R1 preserves the approved camera origins and evaluates tree-tier changes against that locked set rather than changing sightlines.

exemptions.name: final-view
exemptions.rationale: The hero clearing and cabin destination remain the approved final visual hierarchy.
